To confirm the flight booking’s details, we’ll need the exact booking ID that was generated when the reservation was made. If you have that ID, I can pull up the booking record and show you the departure/arrival airports, date, class, price, and any other relevant info. If you don’t have an ID, let me know and we can try to locate the booking again or re‑attempt the booking process.
